report.explanation: Current evidence shows a healthy checkout: gateway span OK at 60ms, p95 72ms, error_rate 0.001, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters. Topology alone does not establish a fault. No observation supports any taxonomy cause, so no bounded candidate can be stated; hand off for targeted dependency and configuration telemetry.
missing_evidence: No error or latency signal in current metrics/traces to localize a fault to any service or dependency.
No per-dependency telemetry (order, inventory, payment, postgresql, redis) to test db-pool, redis-timeout, or downstream-latency causes.
No deployment or configuration-change records to test bad-configuration.
No memory-retention time series to test memory-leak.
